_scope: Ryan dialogue only; complete requirement shapes only. Names come from current reviewed table_names.

ryan.en: Hey, you're not part of our Cult! Get out of here!
ryan.zh: 喂，你不是我们教团的人！快离开这里！

ryan.en: AAAHHHHH! Don't startle me like that bro!
ryan.zh: 啊啊啊！兄弟，别这么吓我！

ryan.en: Y'know, someone as stealthy as you could be a useful member of the Campfire Cult.
ryan.zh: 你知道吗，像你这样身手隐秘的人，加入营火教团一定能派上用场。

ryan.en: What do you say to that?
ryan.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

ryan.en: Cool! Anyways, there's just one thing you have to do before you can join.
ryan.zh: 好极了！不过，加入之前你得先做一件事。

ryan.en: Stand in the CAMPFIRE!
ryan.zh: 站进营火里！

ryan.en: Yeah don't worry, it's not as hot as it looks.
ryan.zh: 放心吧，它没看上去那么烫。

ryan.en: If you can last for %s seconds while standing in the campfire, I'll give you a reward!
ryan.zh: 只要你站在营火里坚持 %s 秒，我就给你奖励！

ryan.en: Wow, you did it!
ryan.zh: 哇，你做到了！

ryan.en: Nice job, hotshot! I'd give you the Campfire Initiate Badge I right now, but I'm out of wood to make one with...
ryan.zh: 干得漂亮，小能手！我本想现在就给你营火新人徽章 I，可惜制作徽章的木材用完了……

ryan.en: Sorry about that...
ryan.zh: 真不好意思……

ryan.en: I need to keep watch and make sure nobody blows out the Campfire, but if you can grab me %s Dark Oak Logs, I'll make one for ya!
ryan.zh: 我得守在这里，确保没人把营火吹灭。你给我带来 %s 个深色橡木原木，我就给你做一枚！

ryan.en: Thanks for the wood! Here's your badge, as promised!
ryan.zh: 谢谢你带来的木材！这是答应给你的徽章！

ryan.en: A Campfire Initiate Badge I, for our latest initiate, %s!
ryan.zh: 这枚营火新人徽章 I，送给我们的新成员 %s！

ryan.en: I can upgrade that badge for you as you survive more Campfire Trials, you know?
ryan.zh: 你知道吗，只要通过更多营火试炼，我就能帮你升级徽章。

ryan.en: Simply stand in the campfire whenever you think you're ready!
ryan.zh: 准备好了就站进营火里吧！

ryan.en: But be careful, though, as each trial burns a little hotter than the last!
ryan.zh: 不过要小心，每次试炼都会比上一次烧得更旺！

ryan.en: Wow! You survived the campfire!
ryan.zh: 哇！你从营火里撑过来了！

ryan.en: The campfire deals both normal damage and true damage.
ryan.zh: 营火会同时造成普通伤害和真实伤害。

ryan.en: Normal damage can be reduced by  Defense.
ryan.zh: 普通伤害可以通过  防御降低。

ryan.en: And true damage can be reduced by  True Defense.
ryan.zh: 而真实伤害可以通过  真实防御降低。

ryan.en: Try to survive the Trial of Fire %s and I'll give you the Campfire Initiate Badge!
ryan.zh: 试着通过烈焰试炼 %s，我就给你营火新人徽章！

ryan.en: Next step is the Trial of Fire %s! (%s damage)
ryan.zh: 下一关是烈焰试炼 %1$s！（承受 %2$s 点伤害）

ryan.en: Step into the campfire to start the trial and survive for %ss!
ryan.zh: 走进营火开始试炼，坚持 %s 秒！

ryan.en: Incredible! Seems like you got the spark for this!
ryan.zh: 真厉害！看来你很有这方面的天赋！

ryan.en: Here's your Campfire Initiate Badge!
ryan.zh: 这是你的营火新人徽章！

ryan.en: Complete the Trial of Fire %s and I'll upgrade your badge!
ryan.zh: 完成烈焰试炼 %s，我就帮你升级徽章！

ryan.en: I need you to hold your %s so I can upgrade it!
ryan.zh: 把 %s 拿在手上，我才能帮你升级！

ryan.en: Your %s has been upgraded to a %s!
ryan.zh: 你的 %1$s 已升级为 %2$s！

ryan.en: Try the Trial of Fire Trial %s for a greater challenge!
ryan.zh: 想挑战更高难度，就来试试烈焰试炼 %s！

ryan.en: The rarity of your item will be upgraded in %s trials!
ryan.zh: 再完成 %s 次试炼，你的物品稀有度就会提升！

ryan.en: The rarity of your item will be upgraded on the next trial!
ryan.zh: 完成下一次试炼，你的物品稀有度就会提升！

ryan.en: Congrats on completing tier %s!
ryan.zh: 恭喜你完成第 %s 级试炼！

ryan.en: You are ready for the next badge rarity!
ryan.zh: 你已经可以将徽章的稀有度再提升一级了！

ryan.en: To receive it, we require %s x%s!
ryan.zh: 想要领取它，需要 %2$s 个%1$s！

ryan.en: Congrats! Your %s was upgraded to a %s!
ryan.zh: 恭喜！你的 %1$s 已升级为 %2$s！
